rules: The selector is derived from current authority on every invocation; it is not a hard-coded alias menu.
Selecting an option does not create or mutate aliases.
Explicit-only or HOLD tasks must be visibly labelled and never silently selected by a bare inheritance request.
Once an option is selected, continue with normal authority loading and freshness checks.
Selecting a domain task establishes authority_context=DOMAIN:<domain_id>; selecting controller establishes authority_context=UAOS.

authority_context.parent_upcall_rule: A child may invoke UAOS guidance without replacing the selected child task authority; parent consultation is not a hidden child privilege escalation.

adaptive_deliberation.rule: Report the actual escalation used (for example macro alignment, external research, counterexample or independent verification) rather than claiming generic self-reflection.

inherited_session_progress_report.timestamp_rule: Use the timestamp of the freshest authoritative state actually used for the report; do not substitute the response clock when authority freshness is known.
inherited_session_progress_report.version_rule: Report system/domain/task version identities that materially govern the current action. Schema version alone is not a release version.
inherited_session_progress_report.evolution_rule: If a user correction/failure/maintenance finding triggered governed evolution, report the actual durable lifecycle state and evolution_id; otherwise report NO_EVOLUTION_TRIGGER.
inherited_session_progress_report.deliberation_rule: When adaptive deliberation materially changed the path, report which escalation dimensions were used; do not expose private chain-of-thought or fabricate independent review.
inherited_session_progress_report.assurance_rule: If progress, authority scope, deliberation/evolution state or version freshness cannot be verified, label it UNVERIFIED or UNKNOWN rather than fabricating a value.
